007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.Profile;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SyntheticDataParams;
014import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SyntheticDataSingleRequest;
015import org.slf4j.Logger;
016import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
017
018/**
019 * Sample for generating synthetic data with a single-object request.
020 *
021 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, open a
022 * {@link Profile}, build a {@link SyntheticDataSingleRequest}, and call
023 * {@link Profile#generateSyntheticData(SyntheticDataSingleRequest)}.</p>
024 *
025 * <p>This sample changes database state by generating synthetic data for the
026 * requested database object.</p>
027 *
028 * <p>When running this sample individually, ensure the target table or object
029 * identified by the synthetic-data environment variables already exists and is
030 * visible to {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER}. The integration script creates its
031 * synthetic-data validation table before running synthetic-data samples.</p>
032 *
033 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
034 * <ul>
035 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
036 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
037 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
038 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME</li>
039 *   <li>SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_OBJECT_NAME</li>
040 * </ul>
041 *
042 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
043 * <ul>
044 *   <li>SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_OWNER_NAME</li>
045 *   <li>SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_RECORD_COUNT</li>
046 *   <li>SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_USER_PROMPT</li>
047 *   <li>SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_SAMPLE_ROWS</li>
048 *   <li>SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_TABLE_STATISTICS</li>
049 *   <li>SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_PRIORITY</li>
050 *   <li>SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_COMMENTS</li>
051 * </ul>
052 *
053 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
054 * <pre>{@code
055 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
056 * }</pre>
057 *
058 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
059 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
060 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
061 * <pre>{@code
062 * mvn clean install
063 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
064 * }</pre>
065 *
066 * <p>Compile and run this sample:</p>
067 * <pre>{@code
068 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" -d samples/out samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/profile/GenerateSyntheticDataSingleRequestSample.java
069 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile.GenerateSyntheticDataSingleRequestSample
070 * }</pre>
071 *
072 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
073 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
074 * and diagnostics.</p>
075 */
076public final class GenerateSyntheticDataSingleRequestSample {
077    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(GenerateSyntheticDataSingleRequestSample.class);
078
079    private GenerateSyntheticDataSingleRequestSample() {
080    }
081
082    public static void main(String[] args) {
083        String profileName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME");
084        String objectName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_OBJECT_NAME");
085
086        try {
087            Profile profile = createSelectAI().profile(profileName);
088            SyntheticDataSingleRequest request = buildRequest(objectName);
089            boolean generated = profile.generateSyntheticData(request);
090
091            System.out.printf("Generate synthetic data for '%s' completed: %s%n", objectName, generated);
092        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
093            LOGGER.error("Failed to generate synthetic data for object '{}'.", objectName, e);
094        }
095    }
096
097    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
098        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
099                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
100                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
101                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
102                .build();
103
104        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
105    }
106
107    private static SyntheticDataSingleRequest buildRequest(String objectName) {
108        SyntheticDataSingleRequest.Builder builder = SyntheticDataSingleRequest.builder(objectName)
109                .params(buildSyntheticDataParams());
110
111        String ownerName = optionalEnv("SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_OWNER_NAME");
112        if (ownerName != null) {
113            builder.ownerName(ownerName);
114        }
115        Integer recordCount = optionalInteger("SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_RECORD_COUNT");
116        if (recordCount != null) {
117            builder.recordCount(recordCount);
118        }
119        String userPrompt = optionalEnv("SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_USER_PROMPT");
120        if (userPrompt != null) {
121            builder.userPrompt(userPrompt);
122        }
123        return builder.build();
124    }
125
126    private static SyntheticDataParams buildSyntheticDataParams() {
127        SyntheticDataParams.Builder builder = SyntheticDataParams.builder();
128        boolean configured = false;
129
130        Integer sampleRows = optionalInteger("SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_SAMPLE_ROWS");
131        if (sampleRows != null) {
132            builder.sampleRows(sampleRows);
133            configured = true;
134        }
135        Boolean tableStatistics = optionalBoolean("SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_TABLE_STATISTICS");
136        if (tableStatistics != null) {
137            builder.tableStatistics(tableStatistics);
138            configured = true;
139        }
140        String priority = optionalEnv("SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_PRIORITY");
141        if (priority != null) {
142            builder.priority(priority);
143            configured = true;
144        }
145        Boolean comments = optionalBoolean("SELECTAI_SYNTHETIC_COMMENTS");
146        if (comments != null) {
147            builder.comments(comments);
148            configured = true;
149        }
150        return configured ? builder.build() : null;
151    }
152
153    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
154        String value = System.getenv(name);
155        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
156            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
157        }
158        return value;
159    }
160
161    private static String optionalEnv(String name) {
162        String value = System.getenv(name);
163        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? null : value;
164    }
165
166    private static Integer optionalInteger(String name) {
167        String value = optionalEnv(name);
168        return value == null ? null : Integer.valueOf(value);
169    }
170
171    private static Boolean optionalBoolean(String name) {
172        String value = optionalEnv(name);
173        return value == null ? null : Boolean.valueOf(value);
174    }
175}
